quest.title: Perfect Shot
quest.description: Ji Tong from Liyue Harbor seems to have found a way to fix that Kamera of his...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Special Kamera x1

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: Ah, hello. Just the person I wanted to speak to.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Nope, no need. I've figured out what it was.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I finally managed to track down the merchant the other day. The one who sold it to me in the first place.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I told him there was a problem with the Kamera he sold me, but he was having none of it.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Luckily I had all the photos you took for me. Without them, I'd have had no way of convincing him.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: After taking a look at your photos, he finally agreed to take a look at the Kamera he sold to me.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Yesterday, he came to see me and brought a bottle of some sort of potion with him.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: He explained that this Kamera works differently from regular models. You need to add some of this potion to it to make sure the photos turn out normal.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: If you don't add any, the photos turn out just like yours did. Just pages of color, rather than clear images.

choices.text: Good thing that your Kamera's not broken, then.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Well... To be honest, I'm less interested in the Kamera itself now. This potion is what intrigues me...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Think about it. Most people will just buy the Kamera, right? Buy it once, use it forever.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: But this potion is a consumable. So, once you've used it up, you have to buy more if you want to keep using it.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Also, the guy says that different potions will produce photos with different effects. He's currently developing more types...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Maybe... Just maybe, those bottles of potion are where the big business opportunity is.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Ah, sorry. I'm rambling.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Thanks for all your help. Hand me this Kamera, I'll add some potion in for you...

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: I know this is a bit sudden, but... Do you have any interest in Kameras?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Well, this Kamera here is no ordinary Kamera. It uses the latest technology from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: The photos printed by this model all come with a unique effect not offered by standard Kameras.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Hey! I'm telling the absolute truth here. If you don't believe me, you can ask about it at the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I was skeptical at first, too. I played around with it for ages, but couldn't get it working. Eventually, one of the adventurers from the Guild gave me a hand.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Now. You must be wondering, what makes this Kamera so different? Well, it's to do with the internal design.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: It takes a certain kind of potion that adds a special effect during the printing process, making the photos look much better than those printed by your average Kamera.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: What do you think? If you're interested, I can let you play around with this one for a while. It has a limited variety of potions, but enough for you to get a feel for how it works.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I plan to make a trip to Fontaine at some point and purchase some new varieties of potions. So, if you're interested, I hope to have your custom then.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Please, keep this Kamera as a token of my esteem. If you enjoy using it, I'd appreciate your business in the future.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Oh, heh, don't you worry about that side of things. They're already very cheap when purchased individually, and if you plan on buying in bulk, we can discuss discounts...

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: Alright, this Kamera is yours to keep. Take care of it.

choices.text: ...You're just gonna give it to me?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: There's enough potion in there for you to get a good amount of use out of it. Once it runs out... Well, you know where to find me, right?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: While we're on the subject, I'm planning to talk to my contact about importing some new kinds of potions for the Kamera.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: If you find that's something that interests you, I hope to see you here again in the future.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Thought I was just buying a Kamera, turns out I was buying a whole business venture...

choices.text: What happens when the potion runs out?
